headline: AfterQuery reportedly becomes Y Combinator’s fastest-ever unicorn, now valued at $3.2B
context: AI model-training startup AfterQuery has reportedly raised a round that valued it at $3.2 billion, just five months after announcing its $30 million Series A at a $300 million valuation in April.
